map.由气温与相对湿度，先求水汽压 e，再按 Humidex = T + 0.5555: From the air temperature and relative humidity, first find the vapour pressure e, then compute the humid heat index as Humidex = T + 0.5555*(e - 10).
map.加拿大系用气温+水汽压算闷热指数。: The Canadian system computes the sultriness index from air temperature plus vapour pressure.
map.对比炎热指数看中高纬湿热。: Compare with the heat index for humid heat at middle and high latitudes.
map.高温预警参考 Humidex 分级。: High temperature warnings refer to the Humidex grading.
map.：30°C、水汽压 e≈29.6 hPa → Humidex=30+0.5555: : At 30°C with vapour pressure e about 29.6 hPa, Humidex = 30 + 0.5555 x (29.6 - 10) = 30 + 10.9, about 40.9, which falls in the "extreme discomfort" class.
map.：Humidex 30–39 不适、40–44 痛苦、45–49 危险、≥50: : Humidex 30-39 is discomfort, 40-44 is distressing, 45-49 is dangerous, and 50 or above is extremely dangerous; this example at 40.9 falls in the distressing class.
map.Humidex 和 Heat Index 区别？: Difference between Humidex and Heat Index?
map.都用温湿，但 Humidex 直接加「水汽压修正项(0.5555(e−10))」: Both use temperature and humidity, but Humidex directly adds a vapour pressure correction term (0.5555(e-10)) while the Heat Index uses a full polynomial; the values are close but the definitions differ slightly.
map.水汽压 e=RH/100×饱和水汽压（Tetens 式），再代入 Humidex: Vapour pressure e = RH/100 x saturation vapour pressure (Tetens formula), then substitute it into Humidex.
